description: A PostHog early access feature: a feature users can opt in to from your app, backed by a feature flag that is enabled for opted-in users once the feature reaches an active stage.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the early access feature belongs to.

Id.description: The PostHog early access feature ID (a UUID).

Name.description: Name of the early access feature.

Description.description: A longer description of what the feature does, shown to users in the opt-in UI.

Stage.description: Lifecycle stage. Moving to an active stage (alpha, beta, general-availability) enables the feature flag for opted-in users.

DocumentationUrl.description: URL of external documentation for the feature, shown to users in the opt-in UI.

ImageUrl.description: URL of an image that shows the feature, such as a screenshot, shown to users in the opt-in UI.

FeatureFlagId.description: ID of an existing feature flag to link. If omitted, PostHog creates a new flag from the feature name. The flag must not already be linked to another feature, must not belong to another product such as a survey or experiment, and must not be group-based or multivariate. Only accepted on create.

Payload.description: JSON metadata for the feature's flag payload (use Fn::ToJsonString). Only accepted on create, and not read back.

LinkedFeatureFlagId.description: ID of the feature flag backing this feature (the one given in FeatureFlagId, or the one PostHog created).

FeatureFlagKey.description: Key of the feature flag backing this feature.
